NONE: › a medical condition that makes you unable to remember things

example: After the accident he suffered periods of amnesia.
那起事故後，他罹患失憶症，發作了幾次。

C or U: › [ C or U ] a decision by a government that allows political prisoners to go free
C usually singular: › [ C usually singular ] a fixed period of time during which people are not punished for committing a particular crime

example: Most political prisoners were freed under the terms of the amnesty.
大多數政治犯按照大赦的條款獲得了自由。
People who hand in illegal weapons will not be prosecuted during the amnesty.
在赦免期內交出非法武器的人將不會受到起訴。
The government refused to declare an amnesty for people who had not paid the disputed tax.
對於那些未繳納有爭議的稅款者，政府拒絕給予寬限。
